title: Room Maze Generator
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: ROOM MAZE GENERATOR SAVE01
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Increasing lines; common pointer base 17125; exact end marker/EOF; byte-identical left/right payload

10 CLEAR 50:DEFINT A-Z
20 XM=21:YM=11:PN= (XM/2)*(YM/2):DN=XM*YM:CM=XM*YM/2
40 DIM B(XM,YM),PS(PN),PE(PN),DP(DN),DX(DN),DY(DN),CX(CM),CY(CM),C1(CM),C2(CM)
50 RM=15
60 CLS
70 FOR RC=1TO RM
80 XD=RND(4)*2-1:YD=RND(4)*2-1
90 XS= RND(  (XM-XD-2+1)/2)*2:YS=RND( (YM-YD-2+1)/2)*2
100 FOR XC=XS+1 TO XS+XD:FOR YC=YS+1 TO YS+YD:B(XC,YC)=0:NEXTYC,XC
110 FOR XC=XS TO XS+XD+1:B( XC,YS)=-1:B(XC,YS+YD+1)=-1:NEXTXC
120 FOR YC=YS TO YS+YD+1:B( XS,YC)=-1:B(XS+XD+1,YC)=-1:NEXTYC
130 NEXT RC
